candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Closure protects the native Paiute cutthroat trout, whose entire historical range was Silver King Creek above a barrier falls upstream of the confluence with Snodgrass Creek; CDFW has been actively restoring the species to this reach.

candidates.summary: Closed to all fishing all year on Silver King Creek and tributaries upstream of the confluence with Snodgrass Creek

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+

schedule.note: USFS/CDFW/USFWS translocate Paiute cutthroat trout from donor populations (e.g. North Fork Cottonwood Creek, Coyote Valley Creek, Corral Valley Creek) into Silver King Creek as an ongoing native-species restoration effort; the forest's fisheries biologist states translocations 'will need to continue yearly until a self-sustaining population has been established.'
